<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Drafting the improved Fruits of the Spirit index.

The index will use Galatians 5:22-23 as its key scripture and order the nine fruits by that passage. It will strip out duplicated levels and instead organize content around an engine section, the ordered fruit list, kingdom echoes, discernment themes, and PKM cross-links. Relationships will be trimmed to hub-level connections rather than individual fruit links.

Also fixing the bible shortcode format across connected fruit notes. The faithfulness note already uses the correct ref= syntax, while others still rely on legacy positional parameters. This standardizes the reference style for consistency.

The index will clarify that self-control is a PKM skill, not a spirit fruit note. It will link to related fruit notes and note the PKM split for that concept.

Updating the Eternal Principles line to mark the Fruits of the Spirit note as a hub. The existing Walk by the Spirit and Abide in Me references already connect well to the fruit cluster.

Batch-fixing six fruit notes—love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, and goodness—to match the faithfulness pattern with ref= and explanation bullets. Mercy will be removed from the index because it does not appear in Galatians 5:22-23. The index YAML is being drafted with note_kind set to index and a descriptive meta title.

The index description frames the cluster as Spirit-grown character, not a merit checklist. The key concept passage cites Galatians 5:22-23 and emphasizes that love through self-control is one unified cluster. It explains that each fruit was split into a single-claim note for easier linking and drilling. It also contrasts daily walk by the Spirit with abiding in the vine, stressing that fruit grows from connection rather than willpower.

The index will frame fruit growth as confirmation of belonging under Free Grace, not a merit checklist that buys heaven. It will direct readers to Walk by the Spirit for the engine, then let them wander the nine fruits by what they lack today.

The index body now opens with a "Start here" section. It points to Walk by the Spirit, Abide in Me, Free Grace, and Sanctification as the engine and foundation. The nine fruits are presented as one cluster from Galatians 5:22-23. Each fruit has a dedicated spine note with six review cards under the Discipleship or Eternal Principles filter.

The index body now lists the nine fruits in Galatians order. It frames Love as the first cluster fruit and Joy as gladness rooted in Christ’s promise.
